integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained. Sharpness is realized by an explicit two-index one-dimensional construction. No numerical experiment, external certificate, or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives the sharp worst-case lower weaving guarantee determined only by the two Bessel upper bounds; a fixed dual pair may have a larger actual universal weaving bound. The operator-valued analogue published in 2025 was available only at abstract/bibliographic level for comparison, so an equivalent formula there remains a residual literature risk.
title: Sharp Bessel-only weaving bound for dual g-frames
